issue_context.title: flashback: add the support to use TSO for the asof expression
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
Currently, `flashback` sql command uses the timestamp string for the asof expression, like `flashback cluster to timestamp '2023-11-07 20:00:00'`.

We need to support the TSO as well. So, the syntax can be `flashback cluster to timestamp '444187140020764673'`

review_comments: I think it's inaccurate to check if it's a valid ts in this way, better to check if there's a related utility function.
